v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius.
text.en: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

text.la: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

text.la: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
text.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

text.la: In Dómino iustificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
text.en: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

text.la: Fratres: Iam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Iesu.
text.en: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Vos qui reliquístis * ómnia, et secúti estis me, céntuplum accipiétis, et vitam ætérnam possidébitis.
text.en: You who left all * and follow me, you will receive hundredfolds, and you will have eternal life.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Bárnabæ Apóstoli tui méritis et intercessióne lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, qui tua per eum benefícia póscimus, dono tuæ grátiæ consequámur.
text.en: O God, Who dost gladden us through the worthy deeds and prayers of thy blessed apostle Barnabas, mercifully grant that all they which seek thy mercy through him may effectually obtain the gift of thy grace.
